model_annotation: The diagram represents imports, exports, and balance in billion US dollars from 2020 to the end of 2023. The x-axis is labeled with years from 2020 to 2023 at regular intervals, while the y-axis on the left side ranges from 0 to 400 in increments of 50, representing the values for imports and exports. The y-axis on the right side ranges from -200 to 400 in increments of 100, representing the balance. The imports are depicted by a blue line, starting at around 150 billion US dollars in 2020 and rising to approximately 320 billion US dollars by the end of 2023, with a notable peak in 2022 and a sharp increase towards the end of 2023. The exports are represented by a purple line, beginning at around 100 billion US dollars in 2020, increasing to roughly 170 billion US dollars by mid-2022, and then stabilizing around 170 billion US dollars until the end of 2023. The balance is shown as blue bars, corresponding to the right y-axis, starting at around -50 billion US dollars in 2020 and fluctuating between -50 and -150 billion US dollars throughout the period, with a significant drop to around -150 billion US dollars by the end of 2023.
